$comment: Two halves, both committed on purpose:
permissions - RosiFit's git guard (binding per CLAUDE.md): origin is the
only remote, and only `git push origin ...` can ever run.
hooks - the app framework's commit guard. The PreToolUse hook fires on
every Bash call in every session; .claude/hooks/pre-tool-use-guard.mjs
bridges it to scripts/hooks/pre-commit-guard.sh and fails OPEN on its
own bugs (only exit 2 blocks), so it cannot wedge a session.
